messages.author: ac3350bb82db2fde
messages.subject: Legend position not working
parts:
Hello there,
 
I tried changing the position of the legend in my plot but it doesn't seem to be moving at all and I am not sure what is wrong Everything else in this code works except for the position of the legend. The code runs just fine but it just doesn't move the legend. The theme () function for the legend position can be found on the last line.
 
Some help would be greatly appreciated!
 
Here is the code:
 
 
ggplot(bigF1S, aes(group_days3, cor_Friend, colour=cor_fdld)) +  
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=cor_Friend-ci, ymax=cor_Friend+ci), width=.2, position=pd) + 
  geom_point(size=3, shape=21 , fill="white", position=pd) + 
  geom_line(aes(group=cor_fdld), position=pd) +  
  scale_colour_hue(name="Mean correlation \nbetween friends' and \nself ratings on", labels=c("First test", "Last test"), l=50) +
  theme(legend.text=element_text(size=12)) + 
  scale_x_discrete ( limits=c("0", "1 to 70",">70"), name="Retest intervals (in days)") + 
  theme (axis.title.x = element_text(size=17))   + 
  scale_y_continuous(name="Correlation", limits=c(0.3, max(bigF1S$cor_Friend + bigF1S$ci + 0.05))) + 
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size=15)) + 
  
  theme(plot.title=element_text(lineheight=.8, face="bold", size=17) + # change the title info.
  theme(legend.justification=c(1,0), legend.position=c(1,1)))
 
Thank You!
Aiden

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: Legend position not working
parts:
This is not a reproducible example since there is no data to accompany
your code. The following is a minimal toy example to illustrate legend
positioning. Unless you know what you're doing with the
legend.justification() specification, just leave it out. In the
following, the values in legend.position() represent relative x and y
locations in the entire graphics region (not the plot region) where
the legend will be centered.


DF <- data.frame(gp = sample(LETTERS[1:3], 100, replace = TRUE),
x = rnorm(100),
y = rnorm(100))

ggplot(DF, aes(x, y, color = gp)) +
theme_bw() +
geom_point() +
ggtitle("A title") +
theme(legend.text=element_text(size=12),
axis.title.x = element_text(size=17),
axis.title.y = element_text(size=15),
plot.title = element_text(lineheight=.8, face="bold", size=17),
legend.position=c(0.9, 0.9))


The way you defined the legend positioning, it was going outside the
plot region in this example. Play with this by changing the following
in the theme() call above:

(1) legend.position = c(1, 1)
(2) keep (1) and add legend.justification = c(1, 0)
(3) keep (1) and modify legend.justification = c(0, 0)

That should give you an idea of what legend.justification() does: it
reorients the center of the legend box to the position defined by
legend.justification() relative to legend.position(). The two go
together: legend.position() indicates where the legend box should
originally be centered and legend.justification() repositions the
center relative to legend.position() - its default value is c(0.5,
0.5).

Dennis
